stackDivergence.rationale: Iteration83 extends the real ScMatrixImpl internal storage slice with original matrix_traits/matrix_flag_traits over existing SharedString blocks and shared mdds multi_type_matrix, all three constructors, Clear, dimensions/count, strict coordinate validation, scalar/single-axis coordinate replication, short-circuit preservation and numeric query. No duplicated container or interpreter stand-in. Ordinary unchanged original definition excerpts compile over genuine pinned mdds/SAL/SVL; declaration scaffolding exposes storage only for caller observations. Complete41517-byte stream covers16dimensions, empty/scalar/vector initialization, copied input values, flags,25coordinate pairs per stage and actual UInt16/UInt8 trait casts. Native constructors debit a global allocation pool; JavaScript deliberately omits the allocation ledger and native destruction/refcount scheduling per the user GC-first instruction. Clear is a content operation, not object deallocation. Original matrix value contract remains implemented. Public ScMatrix, mutations/typed access, interpreter, result/cell/document/input/UI remain incomplete; broad parity flags remain false. Native exception suppression, allocation limits/ABI/concurrency and full upstream QA are not certified. Next full91.
